cd /workspace && timeout 170 python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, random, itertools, time, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
seed=5700
rng=random.Random(seed)
n=rng.choice([24,32,40,48]); print("n",n)
nl=min(128, rng.randint(n, 3*n)); print("nl",nl)
allp=list(itertools.combinations(range(n),2)); rng.shuffle(allp)
tree=[(i,i+1) for i in range(n-1)]
rest=[p for p in allp if p not in set(tree)]
pairs=(tree if rng.random()<0.8 else [])+rest[:max(0,nl-len(tree))]
links=[[u,v,rng.choice([1,2,3,5,8,20])] for (u,v) in pairs[:128]]
k=rng.randint(3,12); parts=sorted(rng.sample(range(n),k)); print("k",k,parts)
per=rng.choice([1,2,3,5]); print("per",per)
env=[[l, rng.randint(1, max(1,links[l][2]))] for l in range(len(links)) if links[l][2]>0]
totcap=sum(per*rr for _,rr in env); target=max(1, totcap//max(1,(2*len(parts)-2)))
dem=[]
for v in parts:
    dem.append([v, target//len(parts) if rng.random()<0.7 else 0])
if sum(d for _,d in dem)==0: dem[0][1]=1
print("target",target,"D",sum(d for _,d in dem))
cmds=[{"op":"load","n":n,"links":links,"bookings":[]},
      {"op":"prepare","id":"pa","owner":"o","window":[0,per*3],"period":per,"participants":dem,"envelope":env,"rev":0}]
t0=time.time()
out=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","-B","submission/main.py"],input="\n".join(json.dumps(c) for c in cmds)+"\n",capture_output=True,text=True)
dt=time.time()-t0
r=json.loads(out.stdout.splitlines()[-1])
print("time %.1f"%dt, r.get('status'), r.get('kind'), str(r.get('cut'))[:80])
if 'plan' in r: print("trees",len(r['plan']['trees']),"routes",len(r['plan']['routes']),"recipes",len(r['plan']['recipes']))
PYEOF
